verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair axis for an auth framework that stores user data, but the pack documents no user or account deletion, data purge, or retention-policy feature. Configurable session expiry and session revocation control how long logins stay valid, which is an adjacent control rather than data retention. Community remarks that the data lives in your own database describe a user-side arrangement, not a product capability for retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
